question: Does adding per-group posture feedback to the v0.0.16 group controller (a specific capacity increase, not a rerun) pass the motor gate AND beat the frozen v0.0.13 champion head-to-head with valid games?
context: v0.0.16 primary gate failed (stance 0/24, reach 0/24) but stand time improved in 24/24 paired trials; pre-declared reading 2 (capacity helps; scale up) applies
classification: single-athlete motor diagnostic in the shared two-person world; not boxing, not self-play, not an Elo claim
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)
opponent: frozen v0.0.11 gen4 posture policy (deterministic) in corner B

candidate.kind: GroupFeedbackPolicy (to be implemented before the run): v0.0.16 GroupPolicy (284 params) + per-DynSyn-group gains on the 6 tilt features (pelvis and trunk z-rows: obs 930-932, 948-950) = 138 x 6 = 828 new params
candidate.init: v0.0.16 final_params with all 828 per-group gains = 0 (bit-identical commands to the v0.0.16 candidate at iteration 0)

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)

criteria.primary_motor_gate: stance_pass_rate >= 0.50 AND reach_pass_rate >= 0.50 over the same 24 gate trials (v0.0.15/v0.0.16 seeds, opponent, horizon)
criteria.head_to_head: only if the motor gate passes: the candidate vs the frozen v0.0.13 champion (its gen0 = punch_params(gen4, onset=-3, duration=0, amplitude=2)) at the 0.50 m range reset under anti-stalling, 12 side-swapped noisy seed pairs: valid games > 0 AND one-sided 95% Hoeffding lower bound of the paired mean utility > 0
criteria.secondary: one-sided exact sign test on paired stand ticks vs the v0.0.16 candidate on the 24 gate seeds, p < 0.05
criteria.level_up: v0.0.17 is a level-up (tagged) iff the primary motor gate AND the head-to-head criterion pass

pre_declared_readings: no stand gain over v0.0.16: open-loop/linear feedback capacity is saturated; next lever is recurrent control or jekko's pretrained bridge
stand gain but gate fails: report and scale the same controller
gate passes, head-to-head fails (no valid games or no superiority): engagement still missing; retarget reach
both pass: tag v0.0.17 and preregister a league with the valid-game floor
scripts: to be added with the GroupFeedbackPolicy implementation PR; must read this protocol unchanged
owner_requirements: gb_feedback_0313/0314: pass the motor gate and beat v0.0.13 head-to-head with valid games > 0
gb_feedback_0425: a bigger, specific change, not a rerun
